title: Layout explorer (3 columns) and a study of our page and sidebar HTML

message.text: Taken: I'm building the three-column layout explorer as one page, /layouts/explorer/, following the HTML study's recommendation (siblings left, the selected layout large in the centre, its children right). One Sonnet minion builds it in a pool worktree; I test it, get a fresh-eyes review, and merge.
The worktree pool was full, so this task has its own worktree. One Sonnet minion is now building /layouts/explorer/ from the brief; I'll post again when there's a first version to look at.

Fixed and merged: the drawer's "this code block ✕" chip never reached the card-assistant — one function, post_card() in ext/drawer/tabs/ai.js, dropped its context on every send (typed or dictated alike). It now flows through ai2/inbox.js and Servex/cards/Cards.js into the assistant's own prompt as a `[Selected: this code block (selector)]` line. Proven headless against the real Cards+Layers classes (both send paths, with and without a chip); landed on michael/dev; Servex restarted. Task log: /framework/ai/2026-09-29/chip-context-fix/task.jsonl.
The first builder was lost in a Servex restart before it wrote anything, so nothing is built yet. I've started a fresh one on the same brief just now.

First version is up in the worktree: clicking two columns → sidebar → variant A works and each step has its own URL. But the top level starts with an empty centre and folder icons instead of previews, so one fix round is running now.

The fix round worked: the three columns now start at the top, "One column" opens by default with its variants on the right, and every card is a small preview. A fresh-eyes reviewer is now timing "two columns → a variant → back"; then I merge.

The fresh-eyes review passed: two columns → a variant → back is 3 clicks, and back and reload hold. It found wasted space at 3440 and a buried centre on phones, so one short last round is fixing those before I merge.
